## Summary

Implements ADR 0110 humanoid profiles, portable Humanoid motion, typed Animation Set sources, target-aware resolution, and build/package support.

This request restores the SceneBridge adaptation contract: unsupported cross-skeleton bindings emit diagnostics instead of aborting conversion. A failed primary omits the binding and a failed overlay omits only that layer.
